hook: An engineered compact CRISPR nuclease edits monkey liver at lower doses than Cas9 therapies

readout.label: Editing activity gain in human cells

summary: Screening tens of thousands of Cas12e protein and guide variants yielded X-Editor, which is over 100-fold more active in human cells. Delivered by lipid nanoparticle to monkey liver, it edited two targets at lower doses than published preclinical Cas9 data, with no off-target edits found in human hepatocytes. The comparison is to other studies rather than head to head, and only two targets were tested.
title: Comprehensive engineering of the CasX-Editor to generate a therapeutically optimized genome editor
